system.description:
Your melee attacks can catch bystanders.

Prerequisite: Rapid Strike

Effect: When you damage a target with a single, non-Area Attack using the Rapid Strike Feat, once per turn on your turn, you can immediately make a second attack at a -2 penalty against a second target within your reach. If this attack hits, you deal half of the original attack's damage to that target.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Scum and Villainy
